Examples
The following is an example of calling the GetDropOutMaxMinTmpSize API on
the host. This API obtains the maximum and minimum temporary space sizes
required to complete the DropOut computation, so that developers can select a
proper size in this range as the tiling parameter and pass it to the kernel. For
details about a matching usage example in the kernel, see Examples.
